answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a one-time, non-refundable 60 POA tax. The levy peaks at the zenith of onboarding demand, when fake accounts flood in, then falls 5 POA per honest epoch to 10 POA. Like pigment staining cloth, the payment marks one identity and cannot be reused on another. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA gone forever, while an honest agent pays 60 POA once and earns over a 20-epoch horizon, rewards undiluted.
